title: Downtown House with yard, Geodis Park, 12th south
description:
This house is fully furnished & close to everything Downtown Nashville has to offer... Walk to Geodis Park!  Close to 12th south and Berry Hill 

- Fenced in yard with large table & chairs, grill. 

 - 5 minutes from Broadway, restaurants, dog park, etc 

- Plenty of Free parking 

- 10 mins to the Airport. 

You will love the detail of this home, it has it all. It's the perfect place to post up while in town enjoying everything Nash-Vegas has to offer!!

The space
Stylish home in a quiet neighborhood with everything you should need from washer/dryer, dishwasher, full furnished kitchen, coffee maker, high speed internet / WiFi.

Guest access
There are two parking spots in the back of the house and one in the front and lots of extra parking on the street, if needed. Or, its a short Uber / Lyft ride from anywhere in the city you want to go and bus stops close by as well.

Other things to note
The basement is its own one bedroom fully furnished rental apartment with its own entrance, & not accessible to the house.
